What this changes, and why.

- [ ] A change to what crosses Bluetooth or the LED changed docs/protocol.md first, and
      both sides and the shared test vectors agree.
- [ ] New code has tests, written from the docs rather than from what the code does.
- [ ] Tested on a Pi and a phone, if it touches Bluetooth, the LED, WiFi or the camera.
- [ ] The docs it affects are updated.

CONTRIBUTING.md has the rest.
